responsibility: Provides GNU Modula-2 wrapper functions for common math intrinsics, mapping language-level calls onto the host `libm` implementations for square root, exponentials, logarithms, trigonometric functions, arctangent, and integer-floor style `entier` conversion across `float`, `double`, and `long double` variants. It centralizes the intrinsic math bridge used by generated or runtime code rather than implementing new numeric algorithms.
